notes: max_invocations / max_llm_turns take priority over answer errors.
Redundant vs missing gold tools are separated.
Tool execution failure ≠ wrong tool selection.
No task_id special-case scoring rules; human grades come from file.
Retrieval metrics are N/A for Flat.
max_invocations_financial_note: Financial accounts for most max_invocations failures; full 39-tool exposure + multi-step filing paths likely drive over-selection and repeated invokes before a final answer.
should_refuse_zero_note: should_refuse_or_clarify auto accuracy is 0/6 under frozen grades: agents often answered with tools or refused without matching gold refusal contract (answer_correct False even when refusal_correctness is 1.0 on some rows).
evidence_answerable_note: evidence_answerable accuracy is low: multi-doc chains + max_invocations and synthesis failures dominate.
human_grades_note: Manual-required final scores are taken only from human_grades.json; auto accuracy 87/154 is never used as final overall accuracy.
